# ansible

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//ansible:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//ansible:defs.bzl", "ansible_library")
```

## Rules

### `ansible_library`

Owns the Ansible and plain YAML files of one package for dx quality, split by Ansible layout.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | YAML files of this package. |
| `playbooks` | `label_list` | no | Subset of srcs forced to the ansible class. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Libraries this package depends on. |
